get_job.description: Returns the latest retained status and progress snapshot for a background download job.

search.description: Searches YouTube and returns metadata for matching videos.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Song, artist, or other YouTube search text.

play.description: Chooses the playback method from the configured target type: audio for speakers, DLNA-compatible audio for DLNA, and video for TVs.

favorites_remove.name: Remove online favorite
favorites_remove.description: Removes one saved online favorite by URL.

get_media_targets.description: Returns the speakers, DLNA renderers and TVs selected in the integration options.
